outcome: bacterial contamination of umbilical cord blood units
cohort: Healthy newborns born after 37 full weeks of gestation.
finding: The rate of bacterial contamination in processed umbilical cord blood units was 3.6%, with a higher rate in units from vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The rate of bacterial contamination in processed umbilical cord blood units was higher in units from vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean deliveries.
